art_direction: 32岁原创女主穿完整长袖套装，在图书馆阶梯旁抱书回望。
composition_variation: Create an original 32-year-old anime woman with a dark braided bun and round amber glasses, standing safely beside a low library step stool. She wears an opaque rose-colored long-sleeved blouse, high-waisted full-length charcoal trousers, and flats. A plain closed book rests against her shoulder as she turns with a knowing smile. Use refined watercolor linework, walnut shelves, pale cream walls, and soft dusty sunlight without visible lettering. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
